These Terms & Conditions apply to all Astroworld 420 monthly memberships, temporary entries and day passes. They should be read together with the relevant membership/entry form.
1. Eligibility and ID. Membership/entry is for people aged 18+ only. Members must provide accurate information and show valid ID when requested.

2. Access and conduct. Access is limited to the membership type, operating hours, designated areas and facilities available. Follow staff instructions, respect others and Club property, and do not threaten, harass, damage property or engage in unlawful activity. Membership is personal and cannot be transferred.

3. Fees and validity. Fees, dates and access periods are those written on the relevant form. A day pass is valid only for the stated day; temporary entry is limited to the stated period; monthly membership lasts for the stated subscription period. Any renewal, cancellation or refund is subject to the terms communicated by the Club and applicable law.

4. Safety and prohibited conduct. Use facilities responsibly, report hazards or injuries, and do not enter restricted areas. Do not drive or operate equipment while impaired. No membership or fee permits buying, selling, supplying, sharing or consuming cannabis or any other product in a way prohibited by law.

5. Risk and personal property. Members/visitors should take reasonable care of themselves and their belongings and understand ordinary risks of shared premises and facilities. Nothing here excludes liability or limits a right where the law does not allow it.

6. Privacy and emergencies. Information provided may be used for membership administration, identity checks, safety, emergency response and legal compliance, in line with applicable privacy law (including POPIA). In an emergency, the Club may contact the listed emergency contact or emergency services where reasonably necessary.
7. Breach. The Club may refuse, suspend or end access where identity or eligibility cannot be verified, safety is at risk, or rules/law are materially breached, subject to applicable law.
Member acknowledgement: I confirm that I have read and understood these Terms & Conditions, had the opportunity to ask questions, and agree to comply with them.
